questions.stem:
A question is given followed by two statements I and II. Consider the Question and the Statements and mark the correct option.

Question : What is the integral value of \(k\) for which the expression \(4x^2 - kx + 1\) is positive ?

Statement-I : \(k < -2\)

Statement-II : \(k > -4\)

Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above Question and the Statements ?

options.label: A
options.text: The Question can be answered by using one of the Statements alone, but cannot be answered using the other Statement alone

options.label: B
options.text: The Question can be answered by using either Statement alone

options.label: C
options.text: The Question can be answered by using both the Statements together, but cannot be answered using either Statement alone

options.label: D
options.text: The Question cannot be answered even by using both the Statements together
